'''Hold''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where he could be found on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and trained other [[Sith Warrior]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Hold appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the Sith Warrior class on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
